integrity: The proof is a self-contained geometric gluing argument based on a previously established face characterization. Small-case finite computations are corroboration only, not proof of the all-n statement.
scientific_limitations: The integral wedge splitting is nonequivariant, requires n>=3 and exactly three rows, and does not determine the homotopy of more-row rook general-position complexes. For n=3, the stated integral equivariant homology is an exact extension, not an asserted equivariant splitting. No external audit or publication priority is claimed.
title: Two-dimensional defect spheres in three-row rook-graph general-position complexes
